elevate.move: When real library frames land, keep the system and make it one shoot: each hour band a real photo duotoned amber on the sunlit side and navy on the shaded side of the seam, so the page reads as one roof photographed from 05:00 to 18:00

Stage 14:00 as the climax of the day: the one band that breaks the grid, its stamp set as large as 18:00 and the frame full-bleed to the right edge with the Fix steps laid over its shaded side, so the hottest hour is the loudest band
